newsitem.title: UK: London sugar freight sees more fixtures.
newsitem.headline: London sugar freight sees more fixtures.

text.p: More fixtures were reported by brokers on Thursday, although some are still subject to confirmation of the final details.
New business - Genoc 20-25,000 bulk from Paranagua to Baltic or Black Sea prompt.
Dreyfus 14,900 to 15,500 (revised requirement) Philippines to U.S. Gulf or Atlantic July-Aug.
E D & F Man 14,000 bagged Durban to Iran, 25-31 July.
Benham 6,100 to 6,300 bulk sugar from Belize to US Gulf, end July-early August.
Fixtures - Following fixed on subjects Dreyfus 15,200 to 16,800 South Brazil to Black Sea prompt, 14,000 bagged South Brazil to Red Sea for end-July.
E D & F Man on subjects 19,000 to 19,500 bulk Rosario to US Gulf or Atlantic.
Glencore 22-25,000 bulk Santos to Baltic, Black Sea or Egyptian Mediterranean.
